description: In the base game, bringing cargo to a warehouse earns nothing until it reaches its final destination. With this mod, when your warehouse takes over cargo, its owner pays you a handling fee: 25% of the delivery price for the distance it has already travelled. The full price is still paid at the final destination. Each cargo item pays the fee only once, so moving it between warehouses earns nothing extra. The fee is shown above the vehicle and counts as its transport income, so it appears in the vehicle, line and finance statistics. The share (10%, 25%, 50% or 100%) can be changed in the mod options.
name: Paid Warehouse Deliveries
summary: When your warehouse takes over cargo, its owner pays you a handling fee.
